mapper.sql: e.*,owner.user_name owner_user_name,owner.nick_name owner_nick_name, reviewer.user_name reviewer_user_name,reviewer.nick_name reviewer_nick_name
mapper.select: select from todo_admission_evidence e left join sys_user owner on owner.user_id=e.owner_user_id left join sys_user reviewer on reviewer.user_id=e.reviewer_user_id order by e.gate_code,e.evidence_code
select from todo_admission_evidence e left join sys_user owner on owner.user_id=e.owner_user_id left join sys_user reviewer on reviewer.user_id=e.reviewer_user_id where e.evidence_id=#{evidenceId}
select user_id,user_name,nick_name,dept_id from sys_user where user_id=#{userId} and status='0' and del_flag='0'
select user_id,user_name,nick_name,dept_id from sys_user where status='0' and del_flag='0' order by user_id
select * from todo_admission_evidence_action where action_id=#{actionId} for update
mapper.update: update todo_admission_evidence set owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId},reviewer_user_id=#{reviewerUserId},due_at=#{dueAt},status=#{status}, artifact_ref=#{artifactRef},conclusion=#{conclusion},reviewed_by=#{reviewedBy}, reviewed_time=case when #{status} in ('APPROVED','REJECTED') then sysdate() else null end, update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where evidence_id=#{evidenceId} and version=#{expectedVersion}

update todo_admission_evidence_action set action_status='APPLIED',evidence_id=#{evidenceId},completed_time=sysdate() where action_id=#{actionId} and request_fingerprint=#{requestFingerprint} and action_status='CLAIMED'
